subject: POC success criteria and evaluation plan for SummitAI
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC success criteria and evaluation plan for SummitAI

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed baseline for the POC evaluation so we can lock timelines and owners:

Summary of ask from SummitAI:
- Replace current inference stack for the "routing and intent" service in staging
- Evaluate latency/throughput under 10k daily active queries and estimate cost impact
- Validate response quality on the top 12 intents and rate of hallucination on open text answers

Proposed success criteria (please review and flag anything missing):
1) Latency (performance)
   - P95 generation latency <= 250 ms (measured server-side, excluding network)
2) Throughput
   - Sustained 40 QPS with tail latency SLA (target: 95% of requests under P95)
3) Cost
   - Average inference cost <= $0.006 / token (goal is to be within 20% of current cost)
4) Quality (accuracy + safety)
   - Intent classification accuracy >= 92% on the labeled test set
   - Hallucination rate < 1.5% on the open responses sample (manual review)
5) Availability/ops
   - No more than 2 incidents affecting inference over the 2-week trial window; automated fallback to a smaller model must be in place

Measurement plan (high level):
- Week 0 (prep): sync on dataset, access, and measurement rubric; upload labeled intent set to shared Drive
- Week 1: smoke validation in sandbox + synthetic load test to confirm baseline throughput
- Week 2: production-shadow run (10% traffic split) + live sampling for quality review
- Post-trial: automated scoring with hand-labeled adjudication for ambiguous cases

Proposed timeline and owners:
- Kickoff prep: 2027-04-11 to 2027-04-13 — Owner: Aditya (sales) + Ben (solutions) + Monica (CS)
- Trial run: 2027-04-14 to 2027-04-27 — Owner: Monica (run monitoring, sampling)
- Readout: week of 2027-05-03 — Owner: Aditya (summary + next steps)

Attachments: [Attachment: summitai_poc_metrics_v1.xlsx (xlsx) ] — I attached a metrics template with suggested measurement queries. I can update it after your feedback.

Next steps (please):
1) Sam — confirm the KPI targets above or propose changes (latency/throughput/cost/quality)
2) Provide access to a small labeled intent set and one week of representative traffic logs for sampling
3) Confirm any security/compliance checklist items we need to include before shadowing

Happy to jump on a short call tomorrow if helpful.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao

Subject: Re: POC success criteria and evaluation plan for SummitAI

Aditya —

Appreciate the clear recap. This aligns with our needs; a few quick items: 
- Throughput: could we target 35–40 QPS instead of 40 to account for traffic variability? 40 is fine if it's the lower bound.
- Cost: $0.006/token looks aggressive but reasonable — can you provide a sensitivity table (tokens per request assumptions) before we lock that?
- Quality: we will add a small secondary metric for response appropriateness (manual score 1–5) to catch edge cases.

Security: our security lead asked whether Redwood can provide an SOC-2 attestation copy and confirm that KV caches will not persist customer prompts beyond the trial window.

We can deliver the labeled intent set by EOD 04/05 and will grant a read-only S3 share for logs (will send IAM details to Ben).

Sam
Samuel Teng
Product Manager, SummitAI
sam.teng@summitai.com

Sam / Emily —

Thanks — all good. Quick responses and updates based on your notes: 
- Throughput: we will treat 35 QPS as the nominal target and validate up to 40 QPS during synthetic load. Acceptance will be based on sustained behavior at 35 QPS and no more than 5% degradation at short bursts to 40 QPS.
- Cost sensitivity: attached an updated sheet with token-per-request assumptions and three cost scenarios (p50 / p75 / p95). [Attachment: summitai_poc_metrics_v2.xlsx]
- Security: we'll provide our SOC 2 Type II summary and a short note on cache retention policy (KV cache flushed nightly for trial and logs retained per agreement). Ben will follow up on IAM for S3 access.

Updated measurement/run plan:
- Prep (04/11-04/13): dataset ingest, access, and test harness setup
- Sandbox smoke + ops run (04/14-04/15): internal validation and baseline tuning
- Shadow (10% live traffic, 04/18-04/25): monitor latency, cost per token, sample responses for manual review
- Internal scoring & readout (04/26-05/03): automated metrics + manual adjudication for quality

Owners: Aditya — overall trial coordinator; Ben — infra & S3/IAM; Monica — monitoring, sampling, and ops runbook.

If SummitAI can grant the logs and the labeled set on 04/05 we can hit the prep window above.

I'll schedule a 30-min prep call for Monday 04/11; invite to follow.

Cheers,
Aditya
